verdict.rationale: Anytype documents a live Graph view showing objects and their connections, plus Queries/Views for filtering and Links for tracing relationships (anytype-docs-9, anytype-docs-8, anytype-docs-21, anytype-docs-28, anytype-docs-40), which matches the story's core ask. However, hands-on community feedback directly contradicts the usability of this feature at scale: 'the graph view which is totally useless if you have at least hundreds of objects' (anytype-comm-5), undercutting the claim for a researcher-scale knowledge base. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that graph filtering scales well, and documentation of advanced graph-specific filter controls beyond generic Queries.
